sloka: प्रस्रुतः सर्व गात्रेभ्यः स्वेदः शोक अग्नि सम्भवः ।यथा सूर्य अम्शु सम्तप्तः हिमवान् प्रस्रुतः हिमम् ॥२-८५-१८॥
transliteration: prasrutaḥ sarva gātrebhyaḥ svedaḥ śoka agni sambhavaḥ ।yathā sūrya amśu samtaptaḥ himavān prasrutaḥ himam ॥2-85-18॥

translations.english: Like the ice melted by the heat of the Sun's rays flows down the Himalayas, sweat poured from all parts of his body caused by the fire of grief.
